(3) Calibration prereg deliverable: first-cohort distributions (traders = 6 registered + 22 PROSPECT; portfolios = IV6/EW6/B_MAXDIV/EW + eligible blend cells) -> weight bands + grade bands frozen BEFORE any composite total-score ranking is used (hard-veto faces effective immediately; until calibration = readout cards without composite ranking). (4) Wiring: monthly four-piece + 10-31 first-check consumes the three cards. Discipline: sec.8 five laws (>=2-dimension decisions everywhere; evaluation never overrides gates; data-driven no manual scores; untested = honest placeholder states); selftest incl. untested-state fixtures. Anti-dup: P-6 monthly ops scorecard (firm/scorecard.py) = different artifact (operations face) -- reuse its paper data reads, do not rebuild; CORR_WATCH/g25/t22/t27/t28 result readers = read-only reuse.
